project_description: Converge Go-LIP usage calculation, economic reporting, pricing, and quota/budget settlement onto one simple directional architecture: canonical stream observations become idempotent metering facts, one reducer owns delta/cumulative/correction semantics, one focused accounting application owner coordinates request/attempt measurement, rating and authority, and control-plane/client/legacy outputs become one-way projections. Retire migration-era token reconciliation, runtime usage aggregation/pricing/ledger ownership, direct built-in authority bypasses, and duplicate reporting semantics while preserving provider-edge parsing, streaming, failover, terminal ownership, usage-authority transactions, dual customer/operator perspectives, and public extension seams.
